plain_english: In brief, Lord, hear my definition of pleasure and pain, as they stand for me: union with You, my husband-Lord, is pleasure; separation from You is pain.
sanskrit_cite: saṃgrahena sukhaduḥkhalakṣaṇaṃ māṃ prati sthitam idaṃ śṛṇu prabho saukhyam eṣa bhavatā samāgamaḥ svāminā viraha eva duḥkhitā

plain_english: Even the subtlest inward moment when You do not appear — wipe it out everywhere, Lord, and reveal Your own stainless form.
sanskrit_cite: antar apy atitarām aṇīyasī yā tvadaprathanakālikāsti me tām apīśa parimṛjya sarvataḥ svaṃ svarūpam amalaṃ prakāśaya

plain_english: May living, dying, or anything else be mine — abiding, always worshipping You in Your world-full body at the time of undying consciousness-nectar.
sanskrit_cite: tāvake vapuṣi viśvanirbhare citsudhārasamaye niratyaye tiṣṭhataḥ satatam arcataḥ prabhuṃ jīvitaṃ mṛtam athānyad astu me

plain_english: "I am the Lord, I alone am formed, learned, fortunate — who else is parallel to me in the world?" Such pride shines — supremely — in those who love You.
sanskrit_cite: īśvaro 'ham aham eva rūpavān paṇḍito 'smi subhago 'smi ko 'paraḥ matsamo 'sti jagatīti śobhate mānitā tvadanurāgiṇaḥ param

plain_english: By the awareness of things exactly as they stand, make me fit for worshipping Your feet — me, born of telling non-duality's nectar that swallows renown.
sanskrit_cite: devadeva bhavadadvayāmṛtākhyātisaṃharaṇalabdhajanmanā tad yathāsthitapadārthasaṃvidā māṃ kuruṣva caraṇārcanocitam

plain_english: Meditated upon, then seen, then the Lord Himself is touched. May this worship-festival of Yours be always mine, by Your power.
sanskrit_cite: dhyāyate tad anu dṛśyate tataḥ spṛśyate ca parameśvaraḥ svayam yatra pūjanamahotsavaḥ sa me sarvadāstu bhavato 'nubhāvataḥ

plain_english: Seeing things as they stand, and Your worship-festival — this pair grounds each other, expanding always among devotees.
sanskrit_cite: yady athāsthitapadārthadarśanaṃ yuṣmadarcanamahotsavaś ca yaḥ yugmam etad itaretarāśrayaṃ bhaktiśāliṣu sadā vijṛmbhate

plain_english: Through every sense-door, constantly, may I drink the wine of Your worship-rasa in all-filled feeling-cups — and be mad.
sanskrit_cite: tattadindriyamukhena santataṃ yuṣmadarcanarasāyanāsavam sarvabhāvacaṣakeṣu pūriteṣv āpibann api bhaveyam unmadaḥ

plain_english: Where not an atom is felt as other, and all expands self-shining — there, Lord, keep me standing, Your constant worshipper, in Your city.
sanskrit_cite: anyavedyam aṇumātram asti na svaprakāśam akhilaṃ vijṛmbhate yatra nātha bhavataḥ pure sthitaṃ tatra me kuru sadā tavārcituḥ

plain_english: Though You posted even me to slaves' quarters by Your own will — am I not fit by seeing, even by foot-massage?
sanskrit_cite: dāsadhāmni viniyojito 'py ahaṃ svecchayaiva parameśvara tvayā darśanena na kim asmi pātritaḥ pādasaṃvahanakarmaṇāpi vā

plain_english: At the moment of grace's descent You never deliberate, Lord, never — so what has come over You now, delaying the rite of Your self-revelation to me?
sanskrit_cite: śaktipātasamaye vicāraṇaṃ prāptam īśa na karoṣi karhicit adya māṃ prati kim āgataṃ yataḥ svaprakāśanavidhau vilambase

plain_english: In each object shining outside, and inside joined with the Goddess, may I always behold You, world-full — worshipped by my own hands.
sanskrit_cite: tatra tatra viṣaye bahirvibhāty antare ca parameśvarīyutam tvāṃ jagattritayanirbharaṃ sadā lokayeya nijapāṇipūjitam

plain_english: May I always mount the Master's palace-palace, unobstructed, by mere resolve — bliss-freed in the play of drinking supreme-nectar-wine.
sanskrit_cite: svāmisaudham abhisandhimātrato nirvibandham adhiruhya sarvadā syāṃ prasāda paramāmṛtāsavāpānakeliparilabdhanirvṛtiḥ

plain_english: Whatever wonder arises in all fair things by mere touch — by that the unwavering worship Your body.
sanskrit_cite: yatsamastasubhagārthavastuṣu sparśamātravidhinā camatkṛtim tāṃ samarpayati tena te vapuḥ pūjayanty acalabhaktiśālinaḥ

plain_english: Swelling all by self-shining, You touch the universe touching form; whatever swirls by its own juice — that is the swelling world.
sanskrit_cite: sphārayasy akhilam ātmanā sphuran viśvam āmṛśasi rūpam āmṛśan yat svayaṃ nijarasena ghurṇase tat samullasati bhāvamaṇḍalam

plain_english: Who sees this whole object-circle without construction as Your body, Lord — the world filled with his own self's side — for him, ever-happy, whence fear?
sanskrit_cite: yo 'vikalpam idam arthamaṇḍalaṃ paśyatīśa nikhilaṃ bhavadvapuḥ svātmapakṣaparipūrite jagaty asya nityasukhinaḥ kuto bhayam

plain_english: The kālakūṭa poison set in Your throat's corner is great nectar to me; even taken nectar would be Your body of poison to me, if difference prevails.
sanskrit_cite: kaṇṭhakoṇaviniviṣṭam īśa te kālakūṭam api me mahāmṛtam apy upāttam amṛtaṃ bhavadvapur bhedavṛtti yadi rocate na me

plain_english: Graced with song-mouths lovely with prattling of You, may I be — my heart forever gone to what Your worship-loving prefers.
sanskrit_cite: tvatpralāpamayaraktagītikāni tya yuktavadanopaśobhitaḥ syām athāpi bhavadarcanakriyāpreyasīparigatāśayaḥ sadā

plain_english: Alas, the Supreme's play cannot be counted — and so the nectar-full body He gave me, He does not let me drink as I will.
sanskrit_cite: īhitaṃ na bata pārameśvaraṃ śakyate gaṇayituṃ tathā ca me dattam apy amṛtanirbharaṃ vapuḥ svaṃ na pātum anumanyate tathā

plain_english: Entering You — fathomless, construction-free, non-dual, devourer of all things' meaning — O Umā's Lord, may I always worship and praise.
sanskrit_cite: tvām agādham avikalpam advayaṃ svaṃ svarūpam akhilārthaghasmaram āviśann aham umeśa sarvadā pūjayeyam abhisaṃstuvīya ca
